responses.text: Paladin.
Hello, outsider.
You're being watched, so don't get any ideas.
The bunker takes a little getting used to, doesn't it?
How may I assist you?
Greetings, Elder.
Hello, sir.
Sir.
The reports say Mr. House's robots are now using tech we've never heard of. We need to send a team up there, soon.
Looks like Mr. House is out of the picture. One less thing for us to deal with.
With their leader gone, the Legion will likely tear itself apart. It's what most violent tribal societies do.
Our instruments show some impressive power fluctuations coming from across the river. What's going on over there?
There was a huge explosion east of the Colorado a little while ago. Does the NCR have any artillery that big?
Someone blew up the monorail the NCR uses to travel to the Strip and back. We should use this time to strike!
Seems the destruction of the monorail didn't slow the NCR down much. How many troops do they have?
There was an attempt on the NCR president's life recently. Too bad it didn't succeed.
Did you hear? Someone actually managed to assassinate the NCR's president! And we just sit here!
The other day I heard some bigwig in the NCR military died. Hopefully it disrupts their chain of command some.
Did you hear about that NCR higher up that died? That he was trying to sabotage them? Hope he wasn't the only one.
Seems the NCR is making friends. We've had reports of them making overtures to some gang in Freeside.
We just had word that the town of Primm is now part of the NCR. At this rate, they'll be running the whole region soon.
I heard some special squad of Rangers is on its way to the Vegas area. I guess the NCR is finally getting serious about fighting the Legion.
There've been reports that the NCR is moving more and more troops into the area.
It's the quiet before the storm up top. For once I'm almost glad we're down here.
I still can't believe we came to terms with the NCR.
NCR military transmissions say the robots on the Strip have been upgraded. Wish we had eyes-on intel...
Mr. House is out of the picture. Probably killed by his own robots.
I heard you took out Caesar by yourself. Proves the Legion is just a bunch of savages, like we thought.
With their leader gone, the Legion will likely tear itself apart. It's what most violent tribal societies do.
NCR military radio keeps talking about Mr. House agreeing to join the NCR. What changed his mind?
Someone blew up the monorail the NCR uses to travel to the Strip and back. We should use this time to strike!
Seems the destruction of the monorail didn't slow the NCR down much. How many troops do they have?
There's a rumor going around that you saved the NCR president's life. I'm surprised you have the stones to show your face around here.
There was an attempt on the NCR president's life recently. Too bad it didn't succeed.
Were you the one who killed the NCR president? I'd like to shake your hand!
Did you hear? Someone actually managed to assassinate the NCR's president! And we just sit here!
The other day I heard some bigwig in the NCR military died. Hopefully it disrupts their chain of command some.
Did you hear about that NCR higher up that died? That he was trying to sabotage them? Hope he wasn't the only one.
Seems the NCR is making friends. We've had reports of them making overtures to some gang in Freeside.
We just had word that the town of Primm is now part of the NCR. At this rate, they'll be running the whole region soon.
I heard some special squad of Rangers is on its way to the Vegas area. I guess the NCR is finally getting serious about fighting the Legion.
There've been reports that the NCR is moving more and more troops into the area.
It's the quiet before the storm up top. For once I'm almost glad we're down here.
Keep an eye on Veronica here. She's a sharp one.
Try to keep Veronica out of trouble, would you?
If you're planning to take Veronica with you, be sure to have a good pair of earplugs with you. I'm kidding, Veronica! Put the power fist down!
Where did you get that Eyebot? I've never seen one modified quite like that.
Keep that mutant in line, or we'll put it down.
Oh good, now I have to put up with the stench of rotting ghoul as well. I hope the air filters are working.
I've heard that your friend there can put some of the senior scribes to shame.
Why is your friend there glaring at me like that? Did I bump into him or something?
Don't bother me. I'm on patrol.
Hello, outsider.
I've important work to do, so no time to talk.
Does Ramos know you're walking around without a guard?
Keep up the good work, outsider.
I hear you've been making yourself useful. Unlike some people I could mention.
Are you adjusting to the bunker, outsider?
Just between you and me, I'm glad you're here. This place needed a fresh face.
You've been a great help, outsider. Thank you for all your hard work.
Greetings, {outsider}out- excuse me, I guess I need to stop calling you that, don't I?
So you're one of us now, eh? Truly it is a rare honor.
Oh, it's you.
I'd rather not talk to you, outsider.
I'd rather not associate with you. Excuse me.
Why the Elder didn't just have you shot is beyond me.
Don't talk to me. You've caused more than enough damage.
Ramos is keeping an eye on you, outsider. Remember that.
You certainly make life more interesting, outsider.
Some of the others may look the other way, but I don't trust you.
You're going to have to clean up your act if you want some respect around here, outsider.
Just when I think I've got you figured out, you go and surprise me.
I don't trust you, outsider, but I can't help but like you.
You're alright, outsider. Most of the time, anyway.
We have a duty to preserve the past.
Only a few people get to venture outside, usually to trade for food.
You've been outside. Is the NCR really still hunting us?
McNamara's done a pretty good job, given the situation he was handed.
Our former Elder, Elijah, was obsessed with new technology. That's why we were at HELIOS in the first place.
Hardin owes his life to McNamara. That's why he won't challenge him outright.
As much as I'm sick of Taggart's VR sims, I have to admit we wouldn't be combat ready without them.
Doc Schuler is a lifesaver. I was hurt in training the other day and she fixed me right up.
The Lucky 38's reactor has been restarted... it can be seen from miles away.
Maintaining the machinery around here is important. We have to breathe, after all.
After this I have some weapons to repair.
If I do a good job, I might be up for promotion to Paladin soon.
Power armor is pretty intricately made. It's not an easy thing to fix.
Have you seen the dust storm above? I worked on that machine!
If it's not broken power armor, it's broken electrical fixtures.
If it's not broken weapons, it's broken power armor.
I'm really busy now, sorry.
I don't think these repairs will ever end.
Now, who can tell me the primary components of gunpowder?
The principles of fusion are relatively simple.
...then you bring your second unit up to provide covering fire, like so...
